description: A second herpes simplex encephalitis patient with complete bilateral destruction of the insula was also sentient and self-aware, in a retrospective report by Damasio, Damasio and Tranel, as reported by Philippi et al.
limitations: Reported secondhand in Philippi et al. 2012. The original report is not read here.

sources.quote: patient with complete bilateral destruction of the insular cortex who was also sentient and self-aware
